rationale: Duplicate mapping keys are invalid YAML that tree-sitter recovers. The defect is an IDENTITY one: two symbols shared one id and one qualifiedName, so every relationship endpoint addressed to that key addressed both rows at once -- the graph resolves endpoints by qualified name while the store's own primary key is `${fileId}:${name}:${startLine}`. The second occurrence is disambiguated, is flagged, and gets its own contains edge.

_everyRelationshipCarries.note: asserted by the lane census over 1,274 corpus files: 308,987/308,987 relationships carry a 1-based line_number and an evidenceClass
